title: Circuit breaker
object: B16 miniature circuit breaker (EN 60898-1) cut on its centre plane
idea: The circuit breaker pattern: closed, open, half-open
summary: A bimetal heated by its own I²R bends until it knocks the latch out, so an overload trips after seconds along an inverse-time curve, while above 4 × In the coil's plunger strikes at once. After a trip the latch only holds a reset once the strip has cooled: open, then half-open, then closed again, or straight back to open if the fault is still there.
usedFor: Electrical installation courses: thermal and magnetic trips, type B curves, arc quenching
